notes.title: Website reopening and latest news
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We want to extend a huge thank you to all of you for sticking with us and wishlisting the game! Without any formal promotion, we’re thrilled to announce that we've surpassed 500+ wishlists—what an incredible milestone! 🎉

We’re excited to share some big news about the game's future: Closed Alpha testing is scheduled to begin this December! You’ll have the opportunity to pre-register for the Alpha on our official website when the time comes, so stay tuned for more updates on that.

First and foremost, we want to emphasize that the game will be completely free and will remain free. We’ll dive deeper into this topic in an official video, set to be released this December. Starting now, you can expect a steady stream of news and updates to keep you informed.

In other exciting news, we’re pleased to announce that the official website has been reopened! Head over to playconstraints.com to stay up to date with all the latest developments, sneak peeks, and more.

Since this project is completely self-funded and free to play, growing our wishlist is more important than ever to ensure we can build a vibrant and active player community. Your support means everything, and together we can make this game something special.

Make sure to keep an eye out for the upcoming official announcement where we’ll provide more details on what’s to come. Exciting times are ahead!

Thank you for your continued support, and we can't wait to share more with you soon.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Above Constraints, Centralized Account Testing [Coming Soon]
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, as a few of you know, i'm a solo developer working on this project, been 7 years now mostly of constant reworks.
Lately i dropped the old account system my private testers used to try the client side of the game.
As today i remade the entire system, and now i have my own registration system,
 you will be able to start creating accounts i hope in a few weeks, this will help me monitor if the system works well and accounts get created properly.

The new system helps centralize all of my projects under a unified account named Above Account.
So you won't need anything else other than an Above Account for anything coming from me in the future.


-- Everyone with an Account Created during this test wave will receive an exclusive Above Logo Icon in game once the game move from testing playground to official servers. --
